name: create-conflict-error
prompt: Store.Create in session.go currently overwrites an existing session when the same id is used twice. Change Create to return (Session, error): if the id already exists and has not expired, return the existing session unchanged together with a non-nil error (define ErrConflict for this). Update main.go's call site so it still compiles and returns 409 Conflict on the error.
